At the first meeting of its kind, bringing together mathematicians and theoretical physicists to explore a wide range of questions around order and disorder, I was invited to present my PhD work on geometry-driven hyperuniformity in two dimensions, alongside my more recent work on the semantic topologies of AI-mediated information flow.
